description: This file contains a Perl script implementing optimized SHA-1 hash computation routines for x86_64 architecture, including various SIMD-accelerated paths (SSSE3, AVX, AVX2+BMI, SHA Extensions). It includes code for different CPU features detection, assembly code generation, and performance optimizations for hashing performance.

methods.name: sha1rnds4
methods.description: Generates assembly bytecode for SHA-1 rounds using specific SIMD instructions.

methods.name: sha1op38
methods.description: Generates assembly bytecode for SHA-1 operations using SHA extensions.
